model.failure_model: none; participants are labels and no crash, omission, or Byzantine behavior is inferred
model.quorum_meaning: a configured approval-weight threshold only; no quorum-intersection or distributed-agreement property
model.receipt_validity: schema, voter-roster, per-voter sequence, receipt-id replay, and terminal-state rules only

semantics.proposal: the voter roster, required signoffs, quorum, weights, deadline, and silence policy are immutable
semantics.weights: unlisted voters weigh one; quorum is a weight threshold; a required signoff is always per voter and cannot be synthesized by weight
semantics.vote_sequence: a voter's first effective vote has seq zero and each polarity change increments by exactly one
semantics.same_polarity: a new receipt that repeats the current effective polarity rejects as VOTE_NO_CHANGE and mutates nothing
semantics.receipt_retry: reusing an accepted receipt_id with byte-equivalent canonical action content is an accepted idempotent no-op
semantics.receipt_conflict: reusing an accepted receipt_id with different canonical action content rejects as RECEIPT_REPLAY_CONFLICT and mutates nothing
semantics.tally: effective votes are projected in proposal voter order; tally computation never persists status
semantics.reachable: quorum remains reachable only when approval weight plus pending weight reaches quorum and no required signoff declined
semantics.resolution: resolve rejects no valid open state; it persists a terminal status only when the tally is terminal
semantics.deadline: at or after deadline, silence=approve adds pending weight for quorum but never supplies a required signoff; otherwise an unresolved proposal expires
semantics.terminal: a persisted terminal status never changes; resolve is an accepted no-op and exact prior receipt retries remain idempotent; every new vote rejects
semantics.rejection: a rejected action leaves proposal, votes, events, status, resolved_at, and receipt replay state byte-identical

canonical_json.numbers: safe integers only; floats, exponent forms, negative zero, and non-finite values reject

invariants: required signoffs are unique members of the voter roster
quorum is positive and no greater than total voting weight
accepted effective vote sequences are contiguous per voter
one effective vote exists per voter
vote and tally lists preserve proposal voter order
event sequence values are dense and events describe accepted state mutations only
tally computation does not persist a terminal decision
every rejected action has equal pre_state_sha256 and post_state_sha256

requirements: JavaScript and Python parser classifications agree
JavaScript and Python complete scenario receipts are byte-identical
approval, decline, and pending lists partition the voter roster

non_claims: no message transport, delivery, inbox, subscription, or routing behavior
no actor authentication, authorization, credentials, signatures, or trust roots
no durable receipt store or production replay protection
no database, consensus, leader election, availability, or partition-tolerance proof
no participant failure model, quorum intersection, view change, equivocation defense, or handoff atomicity
no runtime execution, side-effect, provider, process, or clock authority
no compatibility claim for every current Meshfleet implementation detail
no merge, publication, deployment, activation, or release authority
